wholePhysicalScope: The named summit, Honmaru and Six-Tiered Wall markers corroborate the native survey wall and stair traces.
lodDetails: Four authored levels depict the six mapped tiers, upper retaining walls and stone stairways.
limitations: Surviving upper masonry and paths in the standing hillside ruin. Earlier wooden structures, remote gates and museum interpretation furniture are outside scope.
The six walls are geographically mapped. Their batter, masonry profiles and the rises of individual stones are estimated against the 5-metre terrain and the selected Qualla photographs.
Preserves the unmodified source terrain. Some low foundation remnants and small stair sidewalls are simplified.
